item.title: Grid Integration of AI Data-Center Loads
item.description:
Hosting-capacity and reliability frameworks that quantify the impact of large, uncertain AI data-center demand on distribution networks, with grid-aware load-coordination and energy-storage strategies that expand hosting capacity while preserving reliability.

Related work: “Grid Integration of AI Data Centers: A Critical Review of Energy Storage Solutions,” Advances in Applied Energy, 2026, and “AI Data Center Load Modeling: A Timescale-Based Critical Review” (under review, Applied Energy).

item.title: LLMs as Power-System Decision-Makers
item.description:
Fine-tuned and multi-agent large language models used as operational decision-makers for grid operation and optimization: surrogate scheduling for smart-building energy management, economic dispatch, decentralized Volt/VAR control, and reliability-oriented clustering of DER-rich active distribution networks, as scalable generative alternatives to conventional machine learning.

Related work: Energy and Buildings (2026), IEEE ECCE (2025), and two manuscripts under review at IEEE Transactions on Smart Grid.

item.title: Storage Investment and Carbon Policy under AI Load Growth
item.description:
Game-theoretic (Stackelberg–Bayesian) and deep-reinforcement-learning models for second-life battery investment and EV-charging optimization under AI-driven load growth and carbon regulation, linking sustainability incentives to system-level reliability and cost outcomes.

Related work: NAPS 2026 (accepted) and IEEE PESGM 2025.

item.title: Reliability Assessment under High IBR Penetration
item.description:
Stochastic, probabilistic frameworks that quantify reliability and resource-adequacy metrics for grids dominated by inverter-based resources. Part of the NSF project “Enhancing Grid Reliability and Stability with Distributed Energy Resources” (Award #2321661).

Related work: “Survey of Reliability Challenges and Assessment in Power Grids with High Penetration of Inverter-Based Resources,” Energies, 2024.

item.title: Resilience of Distribution and Interdependent Infrastructure
item.description:
Stochastic infrastructure damage evaluation with fragility curves and network reduction, resilience enhancement of distribution systems by remote-controlled switch placement, and resilience of the electricity–water–transportation nexus with last-mile solar relief pack delivery.

Related work: IEEE Transactions on Power Delivery (2024) and manuscripts under review at IEEE Transactions on Reliability and IEEE Transactions on Smart Grid.

item.title: Forecasting for Hybrid PV/Wind/Battery Microgrids
item.description: Short- and medium-term forecasting models for wind speed, solar irradiance, load, and battery state of charge, integrated into the energy management strategy of a hybrid PV/wind/battery microgrid to improve energy efficiency and dynamic control performance. M.Sc. thesis, Amirkabir University of Technology (2022).

item.title: Cloud Energy Storage for Collaborating Microgrids
item.description:
Cloud energy storage investment through collaboration of microgrids, improving both profit and reliability while accounting for a yearly TSO–DSO reward.

Related work: IEEE Access (2023).

item.title: Generation Expansion Planning with Carbon Policy
item.description:
A game-theoretic optimization model for long-term generation expansion planning that incorporates carbon-curtailment penalties and incentive mechanisms to promote net-zero power systems, solved with teaching–learning-based optimization.

Related work: Computers & Industrial Engineering (2021) and Energies (2022).

item.title: Optimization-Based MPPT under Partial Shading
item.description: A bio-inspired maximum power point tracking algorithm, simulated and implemented to maximize power extraction from photovoltaic panels under partial shading, outperforming the conventional perturb-and-observe method.
